hints.title: Feasibility Upper Bound
hints.text: Each of the first n - 1 trains takes at least 1 whole hour due to integer departure schedules; if n - 1 >= hour, it is impossible.

hints.title: Monotonic Travel Duration
hints.text: Total travel time strictly decreases as train speed increases, enabling range search over speeds.

hints.title: Binary Search Over Integer Speed
hints.text: Binary search candidate speeds between 1 and 10^7, evaluating total time with ceiling division on all but the final leg.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all speeds from 1 up to 10^7 linearly takes O(n * 10^7) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search over answers converges in ~24 iterations evaluating O(n) travel times per step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies ceiling division only to non-final legs and handles floating point comparison.
